text:
maria (PM): Quick sync — need final decision on how we handle customer exceptions for the packaging playbook. Two asks: Acme wants soft cap higher + token rollover; BCorp needs contract clause for burst credits. Thoughts?

devin (Eng): Can we support token rollover without per-customer state? That adds accounting and storage. Maybe handle at billing layer not runtime.

alex (Finance): Rollover affects revenue recognition. If we allow rollover > 30 days we need deferred revenue plan. Prefer capped rollover (max 3 months).

sam (GTM): Acme will sign 12mo commit if we give 10% extra monthly rollover. Sales prefers deterministic add-on SKU instead of ad-hoc exceptions.

kevin (Sales): BCorp needs guaranteed burst capacity in Q4 and an SLA-backed priority during incidents. Is that something only Dedicated supports?

devin (Eng): Priority during incidents is non-trivial. We can add routing priority flags but we'd need capacity reservations. That maps to Dedicated / reserved add-on.

maria (PM): Proposal: expose two levers for exceptions: 1) 'soft-rollover' add-on (SKU) with explicit caps and expiry, 2) 'priority-burst' add-on that includes reserved capacity + fallback policy. Default: no exceptions.

alex (Finance): Pricing suggestion: soft-rollover = 5% surcharge, capped at 3 months, revenue recognized monthly. Priority-burst = premium fee + minimum commit to cover reserved capacity.

sam (GTM): Sales ok with add-ons. Need launch criteria: product must support per-customer tracking, billing integration, docs, and legal T&C for exceptions.

devin (Eng): Eng checklist: telemetry for rollover balances, simple UI to adjust caps, routing tags for priority, automated tests for failover. ETA ~6w if prioritized.

maria (PM): Launch gating: engineering signoff, billing integration, legal-approved contract language. We can do a manual pilot process for one customer if sales needs earlier timeline.

kevin (Sales): Pilot requested for Acme. They want onboarding in ~3 weeks. Manual process acceptable for pilot.

pricing-bot: Created pricing-exception-ticket #1023; notifying legal and billing.

maria (PM): I'll draft a short PRD + pilot runbook and drop the link here when ready.

sam (GTM): :thumbsup:
